description: This file defines the front-end HTML structure and styles for a web-based database viewer application. It includes elements for listing databases and tables, dynamic loading of data via JavaScript, and interactive features such as expanding cells and refreshing database lists.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates the HTML table structure for displaying data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cells, including handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing cell content for better visibility.
